items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What Charlie out in the West? >> [INTERVIEWEE] Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: What Charlie out in the West?

items.title: Danny Barker — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You made a recording with Charlie Parker. That’s right? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Charlie something-else. But Lionel is a Tapo. So it’s as close as I could get to it. It didn’t matter too much to me, because I just put their names down to show you, just give you a inkling of this thing, just enough to see how involved music gets into a family.
Yes, I understand. That’s very common in New Orleans, these musical families.
